final_correction_adjudication.exact_ruling: On newly conquering a region, place its matching Governor overlay IN THE REGION; take the matching Governor office card from unused offices and place ONLY that card in Vacant Offices. The loot/control token is placed region-side faceup above the President.
final_correction_adjudication.rationale: The old shorthand "Governor overlay/card to vacant stack" wrongly grouped two distinct destinations. The corrected key states the preexisting primary-source rule precisely. This is a source correction to the same asked control-imposition procedure, not a target relaxation or a new question.
